reading_scope: Complete revised standalone proof, with comparison against the earlier minimum-counterexample, binary-action, weak-embedding and powerful-coordinate arguments; exact primary-source reading of Lubotzky-Mann inherited from phase11.
full_theorem_scope: Every cyclic subgroup TPP triple in every finite 2-group satisfies the subgroup order-product inequality.
reviewed_consequences: Finite nilpotent groups, retaining the earlier odd-prime proof and elementary Sylow decomposition.
Hou-Feng-Leemans Conjecture3.3 source hypertope order bound, retaining the proven flag-transitivity/typed-Helly adapter.
critical_checks: Minimum counterexample has center-disjoint factors, pairwise generation, ratio2, three marked nonzero Frattini classes and minimum factor order4.
Powerful coordinates are justified by ordered factorization plus a separate order equality; TPP alone is not used for injectivity.
Weak embedding is proved by induction without arbitrary power-subgroup nesting assumptions.
The binary square compatibility gives d(K)=3 and a globally fixed marked coordinate on K/K^2.
The d(S)=3 argument allows trivial fourth-power factors before they are excluded; it removes the earlier marked-isobicyclic dependence.
The third layer N=S^2 is powerful by the exponent4 bound on two-subgroups of GL3 and weak embedding.
The N=1 case is excluded by an actual elementary-abelian top layer and an equivariant square map, without the order256 census.
For N nontrivial, equal powerful coordinates make the top-power map a linear equivariant marked isomorphism.
The abstract marked-action lemma needs no exact GOOD/BAD normal forms: its required conclusion is that Phi(P) acts trivially.
The first square map is well-defined from S^2=N and [N,S]<=N^2; the second from K^2=S, S^2=N and [S,K]<=N.
The final contradiction uses only equivariance and preservation of marked coordinates; neither square map is assumed additive.

retained_structural_input.scope: Powerful power-subgroup rules, generation by the corresponding powers of a given generating list, and ordered cyclic factorization for that list.
retained_structural_input.source_reading: Inherited exact primary reading from the frozen phase11 review; no new complete-article reading claimed.
